metadata.description: Per-material regulatory compliance rules for RoHS 3, REACH SVHC, WEEE Directive, EU ESPR 2024, and BIS India standards. Used to populate the Digital Product Passport compliance frameworks section.
metadata.legal_disclaimer: This data is for informational purposes. Always verify with a qualified EHS professional before making regulatory claims.

RoHS3.full_name: EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances Directive 3
RoHS3.citation: EU Directive 2015/863 amending Annex II of 2011/65/EU
RoHS3.scope: Electrical and Electronic Equipment (EEE) placed on EU market
RoHS3.threshold_note: Max concentration values (MCV) apply per homogeneous material

REACH.full_name: Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals
REACH.scope: Chemical substances manufactured or imported in EU ≥1 tonne/year

WEEE.full_name: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Directive
WEEE.scope: EEE placed on EU market — collection, treatment, recovery targets

EU_ESPR_2024.full_name: EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation
EU_ESPR_2024.scope: Digital Product Passport mandatory for regulated product categories from 2026
EU_ESPR_2024.dpp_requirement: Structured data on material composition, recyclability, repairability, and end-of-life

BIS_India.full_name: Bureau of Indian Standards — Mandatory Certification
BIS_India.citation: BIS Act 2016; relevant IS standards per product category
BIS_India.scope: Products under mandatory BIS certification in India (IS marks)

RoHS3.notes: Carbon steel does not contain RoHS-restricted substances at concentrations above MCV. Lead content in free-machining variants (AISI 12L14) may exceed 0.1% — XRF verify if free-machining grade suspected.

REACH.notes: Clean carbon steel scrap is not REACH SVHC-listed. Chromate surface treatments or lead-based paints applied to carbon steel parts may trigger REACH obligations — verify surface treatment history.

WEEE.reason: Carbon steel is not classified as EEE material. No WEEE collection obligation. Standard ferrous scrap stream.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Ferrous scrap — EAF or BOF remelting

BIS_India.disposal_rule: Metal scrap — Scrap Dealer Rules 2013 (Ministry of Steel)

RoHS3.notes: Grey cast iron is RoHS compliant. High silicon content (2–3%). Does not contain restricted substances at concern thresholds.

REACH.notes: Cast iron scrap is not REACH SVHC-listed. Legacy cast iron from pre-1990 equipment may contain graphite flake with trace heavy metal inclusions — not typically an issue at scrap quantities.

WEEE.reason: Not EEE. Standard ferrous scrap stream.

RoHS3.notes: Austenitic stainless steel is RoHS compliant. Chromium (Cr) present ≥16% but as alloying element in substrate, not as restricted hexavalent Cr(VI). Cr(VI) MCV is 0.1% in homogeneous material — metallic Cr is not Cr(VI).

REACH.notes: Metallic stainless steel is not REACH SVHC. Note: Nickel (Ni) is SVHC for skin sensitisation but applies to Ni compounds and skin-contact articles — bulk stainless steel scrap is not restricted. Molybdenum in 316L is not SVHC-listed.

WEEE.reason: Not EEE. Standard non-ferrous high-grade scrap stream.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: SS melt shop — EAF with SS charge

RoHS3.notes: Duplex SS is RoHS compliant. Higher Cr content (22%) remains as metallic alloying element — not Cr(VI). Nitrogen alloying element is non-restricted.

REACH.notes: Duplex stainless steel is not REACH SVHC-listed as bulk metal. Same Ni caveat as austenitic SS — not applicable to bulk scrap.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Specialty SS melt — must stay separate from austenitic to preserve duplex grade
EU_ESPR_2024.key_requirement: XRF verification mandatory to justify Grade A premium routing

RoHS3.notes: Inconel 625 is RoHS compliant. Contains Ni (~62%), Cr (~22%), Mo (~9%), Nb (~4%) as alloying elements. None present as restricted compounds at MCV levels.

svhc_substances_of_concern.relevance: LOW — SVHC applies to Ni compounds and skin-contact articles as articles. Bulk Inconel scrap is not restricted. Ni grinding dust during machining/cutting is occupational health concern (OSHA PEL 1.0 mg/m³).

REACH.status: MONITOR — Ni dust exposure during processing
REACH.notes: Bulk Inconel 625 metal is not SVHC. Worker protection required for any operations generating Ni metal dust.

WEEE.reason: Not EEE. However, Inconel 625 used in EEE applications (e.g. aerospace electronics enclosures) would require WEEE tracking.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Specialty Ni alloy recycler — dedicated Inconel 625 stream. Never mix with Inconel 718 or Hastelloy without XRF.

relevant_standards: DGFT regulations for Ni alloy exports
BIS_India.export_control: Ni superalloys may be subject to SCOMET (dual-use) export controls if aerospace-grade — verify with DGFT before export.

hazardous_classification.worker_health_note: Ni metal dust: OSHA PEL 1.0 mg/m³. Respiratory protection required during cutting/grinding operations.

RoHS3.notes: Hastelloy C-276 is RoHS compliant. Contains Ni (~55%), Mo (~16%), Cr (~16%), W (~4%). Not restricted under RoHS 3 as bulk metal.

svhc_substances_of_concern.relevance: LOW — Same as Inconel. PPE required for cutting/grinding.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Dedicated C276 stream — must not contaminate C22 or C2000 scrap

relevant_standards: DGFT SCOMET check for export of Ni-Mo alloys

RoHS3.notes: Titanium alloys are RoHS compliant. No restricted substances at concern levels. Vanadium (V) in Ti-6Al-4V is not SVHC-listed as metallic alloy element.

REACH.notes: Ti-6Al-4V bulk metal is not REACH SVHC. Ti metal dust is flammable (Class 4.1 flammable solid per IMDG) — fire precautions required during machining.

WEEE.reason: Not EEE. Aerospace/medical grade Ti tracked under AS9100/ISO 13485 traceability systems.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Life-expired aviation Ti: MUST be mutilated per FAA AC 20-62E before scrap. Non-life-expired: specialty Ti recycler or certified scrap.
EU_ESPR_2024.critical_requirement: Life limit check mandatory — aviation-grade Ti parts have cycle/hour limits. Exception from MCV for safety-critical parts.

BIS_India.export_control: SCOMET (Schedule 2) — aerospace-grade titanium alloys are dual-use controlled. DGFT Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies list applies.

hazardous_classification.hazard_note: Ti metal dust/powder is a Class 4.1 flammable solid. Machining chips can ignite spontaneously. Fire extinguisher Class D (dry sand) required — water will accelerate Ti fires.

RoHS3.notes: Pure copper is RoHS compliant. Note: Lead-free solder used with copper must also comply. Copper-beryllium alloys (e.g. C17200) are NOT RoHS compliant — verify alloy before classification.

REACH.notes: Copper C110 is not SVHC-listed. Copper compounds (CuSO4, Cu2O, etc.) may be SVHC — not applicable to metallic scrap. Avoid acid-treated copper scrap without confirming residue neutralisation.

WEEE.reason: Copper windings and busbars from EEE (motors, transformers) fall within WEEE scope when derived from categorised EEE equipment.
WEEE.india_e_waste_rule: E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022 — Category 6 (Large Equipment). Producer EPR registered? Check CPCB EPR portal.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Non-ferrous scrap dealer → copper smelter (Hindalco/Sterlite). Strip insulation before delivery.

BIS_India.epr_note: EEE-derived copper covered under Extended Producer Responsibility. Producer must be EPR-registered with CPCB.

restricted_substances_detected: Lead (Pb) — free-machining brass variants may contain Pb > 0.1%
RoHS3.notes: Standard naval brass C464 is RoHS compliant (<0.01% Pb). However, free-machining brass (C36000) contains 2–3% Pb — EXCEEDS RoHS MCV of 0.1%. XRF test required to distinguish C464 from C36000. If Pb > 0.1%: RoHS non-compliant for EEE application.

svhc_substances_of_concern.relevance: HIGH — Lead is SVHC. If brass contains Pb > 0.1% wt and component forms part of an article placed on EU market, SVHC declaration to recipient required per REACH Art. 33.
svhc_substances_of_concern.action_required: XRF verify Pb content. If > 0.1%: issue SVHC notification. Route to Pb-containing brass scrap stream (separate from low-Pb brass).

WEEE.reason: Brass components from EEE (switches, connectors, valve actuators on EEE) fall within WEEE scope.
WEEE.india_e_waste_rule: E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022 — applicable if from EEE equipment

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Jamnagar brass cluster (India) — world's largest. Separate Pb-containing from clean brass.

hazardous_classification.lead_risk: If Pb content confirmed > 1%: Handle as lead-containing waste per HWM Rules 2016. PPE — gloves, no hand-to-mouth contact.

RoHS3.notes: Aluminium alloys are RoHS compliant. Small amounts of Cu, Mg, Si as alloying elements are not restricted. Chrome conversion coatings (Cr(VI) surface treatment) on aluminium may be non-compliant — XRF surface test if chromate-coated.

REACH.notes: Aluminium bulk metal not SVHC. Chromate surface treatments (e.g. Alodine/Iridite) may contain Cr(VI) which is SVHC — check treatment history. Anodising (not chromate) is safe.

WEEE.reason: Aluminium motor frames, housing from EEE are within WEEE scope. Track source application.
WEEE.india_e_waste_rule: E-Waste (Management) Rules 2022 — applicable if sourced from EEE

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Secondary Al smelter — separate 6xxx from 2xxx and 7xxx series for maximum value.

BIS_India.export_ban: Aluminium scrap export currently banned under DGFT — verify current status before export.

RoHS3.notes: PTFE itself is RoHS compliant. However, PTFE production involves PFAS chemicals — not restricted under RoHS 3 as of 2024. EU is reviewing PFAS restriction under REACH.

svhc_substances_of_concern.relevance: HIGH — PFOA is restricted under POPs Regulation (EU 2019/1021) and REACH Annex XVII. PTFE itself is not PFOA, but degradation and thermal processing of PTFE can generate PFOA. Incineration of PTFE at non-specialist facility is prohibited.
svhc_substances_of_concern.action_required: Route to licensed fluoropolymer recycler. NEVER incinerate in standard waste streams.

WEEE.reason: PTFE seals and seats are not EEE. Treated as industrial polymer waste.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Licensed fluoropolymer recycler — processing under controlled temperature (<300°C). Do NOT co-process with other polymers.
EU_ESPR_2024.disposal_restriction: INCINERATION PROHIBITED without licensed POPs incinerator

relevant_standards: Hazardous Waste Management Rules 2016 — Schedule II (Persistent Organic Pollutants)
BIS_India.disposal_rule: PFAS waste requires licensed TSDF (Treatment, Storage and Disposal Facility) authorised by SPCB. Not landfillable.

hazardous_classification.hazard_note: PTFE thermal decomposition above 400°C releases PFIB (perfluoroisobutylene), a highly toxic gas. At 500°C+, PTFE fume fever risk (polymer fume fever). Do NOT weld, burn, or cut with thermal tools without specialist PPE.

RoHS3.notes: Monel 400 (Ni-Cu alloy) is RoHS compliant. No restricted substances at MCV levels as bulk metal.

svhc_substances_of_concern.relevance: LOW — Same as other Ni alloys. Bulk scrap not restricted. PPE for cutting/grinding.

EU_ESPR_2024.end_of_life_route: Monel-specific Ni-Cu alloy recycler. Separate from pure Ni and Inconel streams.

general_india_disposal_rules.hazardous_waste_framework: Hazardous Waste (Management, Handling and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016
general_india_disposal_rules.scrap_dealer_rules: Metal Scrap Dealers Rules 2013 (Ministry of Steel)

key_contacts.CPCB: Central Pollution Control Board — cpcb.nic.in (EPR, WEEE)
key_contacts.MoEFCC: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change — moef.gov.in
key_contacts.DGFT: Directorate General of Foreign Trade — dgft.gov.in (export controls)
